# Famulus Publications

> Three series, one publisher: case studies with their evidence, the platform as it is built, and the concepts it rests on.

## Series

- Famulus Expertise: Single studies that can be checked: every statement about the source can be tested at its place in the source, by readers and by programs. <https://famulus.lettre.ai/expertise/>
- Famulus Platform: A comprehensive, citable description of the platform. Every issue mirrors its version on arXiv and carries its DOI. (in preparation)
- Famulus Fundamentals: A citable foundation on which the issues of Famulus Platform and Famulus Expertise can rely. Every issue mirrors its version on arXiv and carries its DOI. (in preparation)
